messages:
jamie: hey! i'm in week 1 and a bit confused about where to post stuff — setup errors, quick product q's, and when to DM vs post in a channel? also getting lots of bot pings :grimacing:
onboard-bot: 👋 Welcome Jamie! See #new-hires for onboarding checklist. If you hit setup issues, open a thread in #help and tag @marta. For infra/runtime stuff use #eng-infra or #eng-runtime.
marta (People Ops): short cheat: DM me for 1:1 onboarding help. Public channels for anything others might hit. Use threads for troubleshooting so the channel doesn't get noisy. If its purely personal (payroll, benefits) DM People Ops.
alex (Eng): add to that — post reproducible errors in #eng-infra with a minimal snippet. example format we like: ```OS: macOS 13.2\nCommand: ./start.sh\nError: bind: address already in use``` Put that in the root of the thread, then mention eng oncall if its a production hit.
samir (DevEx): bot tips: most alerts come from deploy-bot and pager-bot. You can reduce noise by: 1) muting channel notifications, 2) turning off thread notifications you dont care about, or 3) unsubscribing from specific bot DMs (App settings > Notifications). Also, use reactions to ack: :thumbsup: means seen, :white_check_mark: means resolved.
jamie: awesome, thanks — quick Q on threading: if i ask a question in #product and someone answers, should i reply in thread or start a new message?
marta (People Ops): always reply in-thread for the same issue. start a new message only for a separate topic. threads become the single source of truth for that discussion.
alex (Eng): FYI we also have short guidelines in the handbook: https://intranet.redwood.com/handbook/channels (search "posting guidelines"). If its code or logs, put them in a code block. If its ephemeral (lunch plans, random), post in #random.
jamie: got it. last one — how do i opt into onboarding reminders from onboard-bot?
samir (DevEx): type `/onboard subscribe` in any channel and the bot will DM you a daily checklist for your first 7 days. If you need a slower cadence do `/onboard pace weekly`.
onboard-bot: ✅ Subscribed Jamie to "1-week onboarding". Daily checklist DMs will start tomorrow at 9:00am local.
deploy-bot: [deploy] prod-api v3.14.2 deployed by alex — 2026-03-21 12:02 UTC
jamie: perfect, thanks everyone! will post setup issues to #help with the snippet format and keep follow-ups in-thread. :raised_hands:
